use: Provisional blank shirt mockups. Existing RED logo is overlaid in the website, without redrawing the official mark.
prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent product cutout for a website clothing rail carousel. One single oversized heavyweight cotton crewneck T-shirt, hanging naturally from one black matte triangular clothing hanger with a slim silver metal hook. Perfectly front-facing, centered, symmetric balanced composition, entire hook, hanger, sleeves and hem fully visible. Portrait 1024x1536 framing. Hook centered exactly at x=50%, hook top at y=5%, shirt hem at y=94%, sleeves extend to x=6% and x=94%. The hook must be thin and realistic and above the neckline, with the hanger resting naturally inside the shoulders. Subtle cotton grain, natural relaxed folds, detailed collar ribbing, stitched sleeves and hem, soft premium studio lighting from upper left. Transparent alpha background, clean cutout including the open space in and around the hanger. No wall, no floor, no rail, no drop shadow outside the clothing. No people, no props, no text, no logo or graphic printed on shirt, no watermark. This is a provisional blank merch mockup for RED Coffee Club; a logo will be displayed by the website. Color: warm off-white / natural ecru cotton.
